en_title: GTA 6 Xbox Series S Performance: How Does the Weakest Console Handle the Biggest Game of All Time?
cn_title: 《GTA6》XBOX Series S性能表现：性能最弱的主机如何运行有史以来最庞大的游戏？
opus_summary: 作者试玩《GTA6》的XBOX Series S版后表示，游戏画面整体不错，但边缘锯齿明显，部分场景画面较模糊。帧率分析尚未完成，凭体感游戏运行接近流畅的30帧，场景切换时偶有拖慢。作者强调，体验仅基于游戏开头部分，后续场景的表现仍待检验。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is finally here , and one of the biggest questions heading up to launch is how well the Xbox Series S would handle the game – well, I've finally had the chance to play the game on the tiny Xbox.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》终于来了，而发售前最大的疑问之一就是XBOX Series S运行这款游戏的表现如何——现在，我终于有机会在这台小巧的XBOX上玩到这款游戏了。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar announced a couple weeks ago that all versions of GTA 6 would be 'targeting' 30 fps , and while it's disappointing that even the PS5 Pro won't be able to hit 60 fps, that performance is about what I expected from the Xbox Series S. And while I wait for my framerate analysis to stop running on my first clip of the game, the Xbox Series S version actually seems pretty decent, all things considered.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar几周前宣布，《GTA6》的所有版本都将以30 fps为「目标」。虽然就连PS5 Pro也无法达到60 fps令人失望，但这一性能表现与我对XBOX Series S的预期差不多。在我等待第一段游戏录像的帧率分析结束时，综合考虑各方面因素，XBOX Series S版本实际上看起来相当不错。

paragraphs.en: The Xbox Series S obviously doesn't have the same graphics treats that the PS5 Pro version of the game has, but even without the ray traced shadows and the PSSR, the game holds up well on the 1440p machine. Character models are still extremely detailed, and even has some decent subsurface scattering and the environments are incredibly beautiful, no doubt learning from Rockstar's time with Red Dead Redemption 2.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX Series S显然没有这款游戏PS5 Pro版本所具备的那些画面亮点，但即使没有光线追踪阴影和PSSR，游戏在这台1440p主机上的表现依然不错。角色模型仍然极为精细，甚至还有相当不错的次表面散射效果，环境也美得令人难以置信，这无疑借鉴了Rockstar制作《荒野大镖客：救赎2》时的经验。

paragraphs.en: But where the Xbox Series S falls short is in the finer details. The edge of nearly every surface is aliased, almost looking like there's a border of static around every character and building, particularly around people's hair. There's also an early scene on a boat, where Jason's face is noticeably soft until it zooms closer in, no doubt to save on some GPU resources. But, GTA 6 on the Xbox Series S is using FSR 4 to upscale from 720p up to 1080p, according to Wccftech , so some softness is to be expected.
paragraphs.cn: 但XBOX Series S的不足之处在于更细微的细节。几乎每个表面的边缘都有锯齿，看起来就像每个人物和建筑物周围都有一圈静电影像噪点，尤其是人物的头发周围。游戏早期还有一段船上的场景，Jason的脸明显有些模糊，直到镜头拉近才变清晰，这无疑是为了节省一些GPU资源。不过，据Wccftech报道，XBOX Series S上的《GTA6》使用FSR 4将画面从720p升级至1080p，所以出现一些模糊是意料之中的。

paragraphs.en: The game just went live, and I'm waiting for the framerate analysis to finish on my initial clip of the game (it takes a minute,) but just going off of my gut, it feels like a smooth 30 fps, even on the Xbox Series S. However, it does feel like the game drags occasionally, especially when swapping between scenes, but again that's something that I'll be able to confirm once Trdrop finishes doing its thing.
paragraphs.cn: 游戏刚刚上线，我正在等待最初那段游戏录像的帧率分析完成（这需要一点时间），但仅凭直觉，即便是在XBOX Series S上，游戏感觉也能流畅运行在30 fps。不过，游戏偶尔确实感觉有些迟滞，尤其是在场景切换时，但同样，等Trdrop完成分析后，我就能确认这一点。

paragraphs.en: I didn't get early access to GTA 6, so all of this is based on the first section of the game. The real test of GTA 6's performance is going to be how it handles some of the wild scenes that are sure to come in the later parts fo the game. But, any action game needs to nail the calmer moments if it wants any chance of standing up when you're surrounded by explosions and gunfire, and when it comes to GTA 6 on the Xbox Series S, it mostly nails that baseline. The game looks great, considering the level of hardware available, but you will definitely notice the difference if you put it side-by-side with something like the PS5 Pro.
paragraphs.cn: 我没有提前玩到《GTA6》，所以这些看法都基于游戏的第一个部分。《GTA6》性能表现的真正考验，将是它如何处理游戏后期肯定会出现的一些疯狂场面。不过，任何动作游戏如果想在玩家被爆炸和枪火包围时经受住考验，就需要先把较为平静的时刻做好；就XBOX Series S上的《GTA6》而言，它基本达到了这一基础要求。考虑到现有硬件的水平，游戏画面很出色，但如果将它与PS5 Pro之类的版本并排比较，你肯定会注意到差异。

paragraphs.en: As GTA 6's launch unfolds, we'll be live blogging the game , watching for all the weird and wild stuff that the community finds. IGN also gave GTA 6 a perfect 10, where reviewer Luke Reilly calls it "exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered, Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played. " For everything else GTA 6, stay tuned to IGN.
paragraphs.cn: 随着《GTA6》正式推出，我们将通过实时博客报道这款游戏，关注社区发现的所有稀奇古怪和疯狂的内容。IGN也给《GTA6》打出了10分满分，评测者Luke Reilly称：「《GTA6》细节精致，拥有无穷无尽的探索实验空间，制作上毫不妥协，是我玩过的最令人印象深刻的电子游戏。」有关《GTA6》的其他一切消息，敬请关注IGN。
